instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default generic green with deep obsidian-forest (#0B1510) and emerald-leaf (#10B981) + warm gold accents.

2. Implement the address verification with fuzzy matching for St. Lucie County and Vero Beach zip codes (34945-34990, 32960, 32962, 32963, 32967) and street names (e.g., Tradition, St. Lucie West, Port St. Lucie Blvd, US-1, PGA Village).
3. Build the Acreage Estimator Slider (0.15 - 5.0 acres) calculating instant base pricing: e.g. Base $45 + ($55 * acreage) for weekly cuts, and display bi-weekly option.
4. Add a full Quote Request Dialog using Shadcn Dialog/Form with fields: Full Name, Phone Number, Email, Address, Acreage, Selected Frequency, Service Notes.
5. Provide an 'Owner Settings' drawer or toggle allowing the owner to modify base rates, per-acre multipliers, and add/remove zip codes in real time stored in state or local storage/backend.
6. Prominently display the call-to-action with the business phone (772) 882-9420 featuring click-to-call 'tel:' links.
7. Include all required data-testid attributes on inputs, buttons, sliders, quote results, and modals for automated testing.
